title: Has it changed? A message to a friend

read.intro: First, a chat. Kate's friend sends her an old photo and a message. What do you think the friend asks? Guess, then tap to see the message.
read.hidden: Look what I found! 😄 Remember this place? We're going there in August. Has it changed much since you lived there?
read.reply: Ha, I love that photo! **Yes and no.** The old town is **pretty much the same** — same little streets, same bakery on the corner. But **it's gotten a lot busier**, and **way more touristy**: in summer you can hardly move. They've built a tram line down to the beach, and **quite a few** new hotels **are going up** along the coast. When I lived there, it was a sleepy little place, **whereas now** there's something going on every night. Honestly, **it's not quite as charming as it was** — but you'll still love it. Where are you staying? I'll send you a list of my favorite cafés!

task: A friend sends you an old photo of a place you used to know well — a town where you used to go on vacation, a city you once lived in — and asks: “Has it changed much?” Write your reply — or record it as a voice message.

items: They've knocked down … and built quite a few …
It's getting -er and -er (busier and busier) / more and more …
When I lived there / When I was growing up, …, whereas now …
It's a lot … than it used to be.
It's not quite as … as it was.
I'll send you a list of my favorite …!

plan_instr: Tap the phrases you'd like to use.
produce_instr: Write your reply to your friend. (Prefer to talk? Tap Record it.)
